digest.component_or_area: build-provenance test fixtures and artifact probe workflow
propositions: Whole-tree fixture helpers export all 3,019 checkout files while production hatch_build.py consumes only hatch_build.py, pyproject.toml, and src/rebar/__init__.py, amplifying build time across xdist workers
Live artifact-probe builds with workflow GITHUB_SHA instead of final checkout HEAD, accepting wrong nonempty provenance that violates exact-source identity contract
Xdist session fixture initializes independently on each of three workers, each paying 6.60-6.74s setup for redundant builds
Minimal committed Hatch package through real isolated PEP 517 preserves all semantics while reducing paired build totals from 6.30/9.26s to 2.66/5.43s
Both artifact workflow lanes must derive expected SHA via git rev-parse --short HEAD after final checkout and assert exact equality on wheel and sdist

Replacement fixture creates three-file minimal package with copied production hook, real isolation boundary, and Git tracking; artifact-probe requires exact SHA match to enforce ducal-statuelike-ladybird contract
